role: Software Engineer, Redshift Query Processing / Execution
bullets: Working on the query processing and execution engine of Amazon Redshift.

role: Software Engineer, Redshift Data Plane ZeroETL
bullets: Corrected a shared scheduling rule after 4-RPU replication stalled and returned incorrect results for 15+ customers. Added tracing and integration tests to verify work distribution during rollout.

Led the investigation when an initial zero-ETL load failed across two services. Isolating the difference in how they interpreted Parquet dates and timestamps gave the teams a fix that unblocked ingestion.

Redesigned lock scope after zero-ETL customer clusters across 42 AWS Regions experienced restarts. Separated catalog updates from maintenance and proposed per-integration metrics for lock waits and task duration.
Restored read performance in Aurora MySQL 8.4 by correcting a regression in the threads that handle read I/O.
Made SQL digest length configurable at startup so operators could retain their chosen setting across restarts.
Proposed and implemented materialized views for QuickSight dashboards. Analytics performance improved 10×, and dashboards that had timed out returned results in five seconds.
A new Spark pipeline cut analytics job runtime by 30%. Helped build the RDS-to-Redshift pipelines that supplied analytics under a two-hour delivery SLA.
Maintained production Solr search on AWS and investigated queries that timed out.
Built a test framework that could stub multiple AWS clients in one unit test.

Worked with two architects to redesign the Metadata Framework’s CRUD APIs. The new implementation halved memory use, improved API performance sixfold, and supported onboarding enterprises with more than one million employees.
Benchmarked the old and new programming models with JProfiler and shared the results so 12 module teams could evaluate the change.

Designed a persistence proxy so high-volume objects could move from single-table to multi-table storage without losing customer data. Batching and pagination addressed out-of-memory failures on objects of about 4 GB.
Built the Generic Object Change Request service and OData APIs in the Java and Spring extensibility platform. Tuned schemas, stored procedures, and SQL across Oracle and SAP HANA.
Analyzed feasibility of Windows Narrator recognizing PDF hyperlinks in the Edge PDF reader to help accessibility users.
